title: Bound on a list entry
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a,N,p,\mathrm{top}$ be natural numbers, and let $l$ be a list of natural numbers such that its length is $N$, its entries agree with $\mu(a+i)$ for $0\le i<N$ (after viewing each entry as an integer), every entry is less than $p$, and $a+N\le \mathrm{top}$. For every $i<N$, the entry of $l$ at index $i$, using $0$ as the default when the index is out of range, is less than $p$.
hypotheses_covered: A list $l$ of natural numbers of length $N$
Agreement of the list with $\mu$ on the segment starting at $a$
Every list entry is less than $p$
